column1: # baseline and enough room for the milestone-5 embedded HTML/JS. The ~2 MB
# tail after ota_1 is unallocated on purpose — reserved for a spiffs/littlefs
# data partition if we later serve the live-view page from a filesystem
# OTA flashing itself is not implemented yet; this table just makes the layout
# ready so future firmware updates can ship over WiFi without a physical
# re-flash. First-time `pio run -t upload` writes to ota_0; the bootloader
# boots ota_0 by default until otadata says otherwise.
